build: Reality update (Steam 2022-12-18; 2-year anniversary update 2024-12-18; Android build updated 2026-10-09)

package.basis: Desk only: Steam store/appdetails, 490 English Steam reviews via the review API, Steam news, the Google Play listing, and the Antimatter Dimensions fandom wiki (Shop, Offline Progress, Autobuyers, How to Play); not played.

fun.source: desk estimate: widely called 'the best idle game' with distinct prestige layers and a real ending (91.4% of 3,413 English reviews positive; 4.8 stars of 35.9K on Google Play), but a spartan, silent presentation; below Cookie Clicker 75.5 on feel/aesthetic, above Melvor 65.4 on progression and decisions; promising band, near fun.

evidence.quote: Antimatter Dimensions feels oddly spartan and ascetic.
I think the presentation is its weakest area.
The art and sound design are nonexistent.

dims.note: Text and buttons, with themes; minimal but consistent.

evidence.quote: There are no elaborate animations demonstrating one's antimatter production
Despite most of animations can be disabled in animation options, there is one very big one

dims.note: A few big prestige animations exist (one drew a photosensitivity complaint); otherwise static.

evidence.quote: Visually, the game remains extremely minimalistic, but that simplicity works perfectly for its design philosophy.
opening this modal will instead place you on the How to Play entry most relevant to ... your currently visible tab

maybe a bit slow at the beginning but it gets VERYYY addictive

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~80): first autobuyers before the first Infinity (under 1 h est.); one "slow at the beginning" lapse.

yes there are walls, but they are frontloaded and don't appear much post-reality

dims.note: Rubric anchor (~80). Lapse: "many timewalls are present". Ending for a casual player: ~50 days (a third run) to 3 years (one reviewer: Dec 2022 to Dec 2025).

dims.note: Time-study trees, glyphs, challenge setups and the Automator scripting layer; guides converge many players on one route.

never pressures players into spending money simply to continue progressing

dims.note: Free, uncapped offline catch-up, no energy. Lapses: STD coins (real money) buy permanent multipliers and 6 h/24 h time skips; the mobile build contains ads. Borderline for the paid-skip kill; not set because the game creates no wait to sell (see killNote).

evidence.quote: platforms: Windows and Mac; supported_languages: 'English'
Google Play: 4.8 stars, 35.9K reviews, 1M+ downloads
You can transfer your save between places by using the export function

dims.note: Web, Steam, Android and iOS with save export and an animation toggle; English only; no Steam Cloud (saves in the install folder).

learn.practice: Give each prestige layer its own new mechanic, not a bigger multiplier: the long arc stays fresh because every reset changes what the player decides.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198058892610/recommended/1399720/ "each prestige tier feels different and has unique mechanics"

learn.practice: Front-load the walls and make late play wall-light; a player tolerates an early wait when they can see the game opening up after it.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199876283850/recommended/1399720/ "yes there are walls, but they are frontloaded"

learn.practice: Make the automation ladder the reward (autobuyers from challenges, then a scripting language): a model for Idlever's opt-in pen as the expert layer.
learn.evidence: https://antimatter-dimensions.fandom.com/wiki/Autobuyers "The 12 autobuyers obtained from normal challenges have a starting delay"

learn.practice: Context-sensitive help that opens on the entry for the current tab replaces a tutorial wall.
learn.evidence: https://antimatter-dimensions.fandom.com/wiki/How_to_Play "place you on the How to Play entry most relevant to the game content on your currently visible tab"

package.killNote: paidSkipOfCreatedWait left false by judgment: the Shop sells 6 h/24 h of offline production for STD coins bought with real money (wiki Shop page), but offline progress itself is free and uncapped, so the game does not create a wait in order to sell its skip. A stricter reader may set it true.
